facts: About 8,200 people (2020), the territory's most densely populated town
On Saint Thomas, at the head of Charlotte Amalie Harbor
worth_knowing: Founded in 1666 as Taphus, Danish for "beer house". It was renamed in 1691 for Charlotte Amalie of Hesse-Kassel, wife of the Danish king Christian V.
